segments.text: That Predestination is mutable. For, (according to the common opinion of the Papists) whosoeuer is predestinate, he is contingently predestinated, as well on Gods part, as on mans: whence it followeth, that he which is predestinated, that is, appointed to saluation, may be condemned, and he which is foreknowne, that is, appointed to damnation may be saued.
